name: Tester Wanted
storyline:
YOU! Yes, YOU! How’d you like to become a video game tester?

Help a developer test out several game prototypes he's thrown together in his quest to discover the ultimate formula for creating the perfect video game.

He’ll guide you, watch your every move, and provide insightful comments throughout your journey and tests. (Insightful? Really?)

These levels will put to the test:
Your patience
Your willpower
Your logic
Your deduction skills
Your calm
Your perseverance
Your patience twice
Your emotions
Your improvisation

While his work borders on perfection (it doesn’t), you might very occasionally run into some minor bugs. (He once took down the power in the entire building after a patch.)

You'll explore a wide variety of game genres, puzzles, shooters, collectathons, renovation sims, horror, suspense, walking simulators, RPGs… and more.
All these levels are based on 100% original ideas, carefully crafted specifically for his work. (Not true at all.)

No one’s expecting perfection from you, mistakes are human, and we’re all human! (What are you even talking about?)

See you soon! I can’t wait to see how you’ll handle it all and help me reach my goals!

(...And he forgot to write this in the third person.)
summary: Help an incompetent game developer test out a bunch of game ideas he came up with in a desperate attempt to make it big. Don’t worry, everything will totally go according to plan! He’ll be keeping an eye on your progress anyway.
